name: Restartable DDA for Voxel Traversal
definition: A restartable Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) algorithm for traversing a 3D voxel grid. It allows the ray direction to be changed mid-walk (e.g., for refraction) by re-initializing the state structure without restarting the entire traversal from the original origin.
summary: Restartable DDA for Voxel Traversal is a floating-point DDA algorithm that allows mid-walk ray direction changes without restarting traversal, distinct from standard DDA by its re-initialization support.
